title: Dataset exploration protected reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong submission for Dataset exploration should complete this objective: Inspect a built-in dataset. It should demonstrate the expected outcome (Identify features, targets, and shapes.), use a consistent and reproducible setup, report evidence rather than speculation, and address the limitation: Report sample count, feature count, target labels, and relevant data types.
explanation: Review the result for technical correctness and reproducibility. The automatic check only looks for load_iris, shape, target and does not run the learner code. Report sample count, feature count, target labels, and relevant data types.
